risks.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
risks.description: VB6 legacy code uses unparameterized SQL queries that are vulnerable to injection attacks

risks.title: Event Handler Behavior Loss
risks.description: VB6 event-driven patterns may not translate directly to C# without careful analysis

remediation_backlog.title: Eliminate SQL Injection Vulnerabilities
remediation_backlog.problem_statement: VB6 legacy code contains unparameterized SQL queries vulnerable to injection attacks
remediation_backlog.risk_if_unaddressed: Critical security vulnerability allowing unauthorized data access and manipulation
remediation_backlog.suggested_approach: Replace all string concatenation SQL with parameterized queries using Entity Framework or Dapper in C#
success_criteria: All SQL queries use parameterized approach
Static analysis confirms no string concatenation in database operations

remediation_backlog.title: Create VB6 to C# Event Handler Mapping
remediation_backlog.problem_statement: VB6 event handlers need precise behavioral mapping to C# equivalents
remediation_backlog.risk_if_unaddressed: Loss of critical business logic and user interaction patterns
remediation_backlog.suggested_approach: Create comprehensive mapping document and automated conversion templates
success_criteria: All VB6 events mapped to C# equivalents
Conversion templates available for common patterns

remediation_backlog.title: Complete Database Schema Analysis
remediation_backlog.problem_statement: Source database schema unknown, creating migration planning gaps
remediation_backlog.risk_if_unaddressed: Data integrity issues and incomplete migration
remediation_backlog.suggested_approach: Use database reverse engineering tools to extract complete schema and data relationships

remediation_backlog.title: Replace ADO Recordsets with Modern Data Access
remediation_backlog.problem_statement: ADO recordset patterns are obsolete and need modern replacement
remediation_backlog.suggested_approach: Implement Entity Framework Core with PostgreSQL provider
success_criteria: All ADO recordsets replaced with EF Core
